vulgar.gloss: of or associated with the great masses of people

vulgar.gloss: being or characteristic of or appropriate to everyday language

vulnerable.gloss: susceptible to criticism or persuasion or temptation
capable of being wounded or hurt

vulture.gloss: any of various large diurnal birds of prey having naked heads and weak claws and feeding chiefly on carrion

vulva.gloss: external parts of the female genitalia
